merge_basis: Candidate T0017 concerns Zongertinib in adjuvant NSCLC (Beamion LUNG-3, study 1479-0032), which is a distinct indication and study from all existing groups: G0003 covers 1L NSCLC NDA approval timeline, G0011 covers a China-alone IIS in NSCLC, and G0012/G0015 cover breast cancer 2L and gastric cancer 2L Phase 3 trials respectively. Different study number and clinical setting (adjuvant vs. 1L/2L) preclude merging.
